backup.save_hint: The file holds your configuration and the settings of every skill. Keep it somewhere safe.
backup.restore_hint: This replaces your configuration and your skill settings with the ones in the file. The current files are kept as backups on the device, so you can undo it.
backup.confirm_restore_prefix: Replace the settings on this device with the ones in
backup.confirm_restore_suffix: ? The current files are kept as backups.
backup.unchanged_suffix: file(s) already matched the backup and were left as they were.
backup.undo_hint: You will be asked to confirm first, and the replaced files are kept on the device, so you can undo this.
backup.history_heading: Go back to an earlier save
backup.history_hint: Every save keeps the file it replaced, right here on the device. Pick one to look at it or put it back.
backup.history_empty: No saved versions yet. They appear after your first save.
backup.revert_hint: The file it replaces is backed up first, so a revert can be reverted.
backup.confirm_revert: Put this earlier version back? The current file is kept as a backup.
backup.reverted: Done. The earlier version is back in place.
